denext/directive-placement: "use client" is ignored where it is
  at lint-directive.tsx:3:1

    2 | import { useState } from "denext";
  > 3 | "use client";
        ^^^^^^^^^^^^^
    4 | 

  A directive only counts as the module's first statement (comments may come before it). Below an import it is just a string expression, so the module silently stays a Server Component module.

  Fix: Move `"use client";` to the top of the file, above every import.

  Original (deno lint):
  │ error[denext/directive-placement]: "use client" must be the module's leading statement to take effect. [denext/directive-placement]
  │  --> /app/lint-directive.tsx:3:1
  │   | 
  │ 3 | "use client";
  │   | ^^^^^^^^^^^^^

Checked 1 file
